![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

In `buildVisualDisplayGate`, `student_display_blocked` is set directly to `visualDiagnosisBlocked`. However, `studentDisplayEligibleFinal` and `completeStudentFacingQuestion` are general eligibility flags that apply to all questions (both text-only and visual-required). If either of these is `false`, student display should be blocked regardless of whether the question requires an image context. Currently, if `visualRequired` is `false`, `visualDiagnosisBlocked` is `false`, which means `student_display_blocked` will also be `false` even if `studentDisplayEligibleFinal` is `false`. Decoupling `studentDisplayBlocked` from `visualDiagnosisBlocked` ensures these general flags are respected for text-only questions.

```javascript
  const visualDiagnosisBlocked = visualRequired && (
    !studentDisplayEligibleFinal
    || !completeStudentFacingQuestion
    || !figureDisplayAllowed
    || !rightsAllowed
    || displayBlocked
    || visualDiagnosisPostureBlocked
    || visualBlockerPresent
  );
  const studentDisplayBlocked = !studentDisplayEligibleFinal
    || !completeStudentFacingQuestion
    || visualDiagnosisBlocked;

  return {
    figureAssetPosture,
    rightsDisplayStatus,
    displayPosture,
    sourceDisplayPosture,
    visualDependentDiagnosisPosture,
    sourceVisualRequirement,
    requiresImageContext,
    studentDisplayEligibleFinal,
    completeStudentFacingQuestion,
    visualDiagnosisBlocked,
    studentDisplayBlocked,
    visualBlockerIds: blockerIds.filter(Boolean),
```

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

In `normalizeCopilotContextPacket`, spreading `postureContext` after `source` means that any static posture fields extracted from the question row will silently overwrite explicit overrides passed in the `contextPacket` (e.g., during testing or specific runtime flows). Swapping the spread order allows explicit properties in `source` to take precedence.

```suggestion
    ...postureContext,
    ...source,
```
